user.title: Health Hub
user.description: Receives your band's data from the Health Hub phone app. After adding it, set up the phone app with this Home Assistant address and an admin user's long-lived access token.

abort.single_instance_allowed: Health Hub is already set up.

data.retention_days: Days of minute-level detail to keep
data.overlap_hours: Hours of recent data to re-check on each sync

data_description.retention_days: Hourly and daily history is kept for good; this only limits the minute-by-minute detail.
data_description.overlap_hours: Gadgetbridge updates some recent rows after the fact, so each sync re-reads this much.

import_history.title: Import history
import_history.description: Upload a history file made with the Health Hub converter (for example fitbit-history.json.gz). Days your band recorded keep the band's data. Importing the same file again replaces the earlier import.

error.invalid_file: That isn't a Health Hub history file: {error}
error.unknown: The file couldn't be imported. See the Home Assistant log for details.

abort.history_imported: Imported {hours} hours of activity, {days} days of daily values, {sleeps} sleeps and {measurements} weigh-ins. Home Assistant writes the charts in the background; on an HA Green allow about 10 minutes.

rebuild_statistics.name: Rebuild statistics
rebuild_statistics.description: Rewrites all Health Hub long-term statistics from its stored data, for example after an import or a fix.
